# Elimenti

> Website design for independent businesses, built on WordPress or custom-coded. Based in Hinsdale, Illinois, serving Chicago's western suburbs and clients anywhere in the US.

Key facts:

- Every project, on WordPress or custom-coded, is scoped individually. The exact price and timeline come in a written proposal before any work starts.
- Site Care: a monthly plan or hourly edits, with a five-business-day turnaround.
- Founder: Hashim H.
- Contact: (630) 509-8822, hello@elimenti.com, or https://elimenti.com/contact/

## Services

- [High-End Web Design in the Chicago Suburbs](https://elimenti.com/): Websites designed, written and built for independent businesses in Hinsdale and Chicago's western suburbs, on WordPress you can edit or custom-coded.
- [Custom Website Design for Chicago Businesses](https://elimenti.com/custom-websites/): Custom-designed websites for independent businesses in Chicago and the suburbs, built on WordPress or custom-coded. Copywriting and basic SEO included.
- [WordPress Website Design for Chicago Businesses](https://elimenti.com/wordpress-websites/): Custom-designed WordPress websites for independent businesses in Chicago and the suburbs: your own login, a launch walkthrough, updates through Site Care.
- [Website Care and Maintenance, Chicago Suburbs](https://elimenti.com/site-care/): Site Care keeps your website current: a monthly plan or hourly edits, five-business-day turnaround, with WordPress updates and backups on the monthly plan.
- [How a Web Design Project Works](https://elimenti.com/pricing/): How an Elimenti website project works: what's included, what moves the price, the steps from first call to launch, timing, payment and ownership.

## Industries

- [Med Spa Website Design in Hinsdale & Oak Brook](https://elimenti.com/med-spa-websites/): Med spa websites for Hinsdale, Oak Brook and the western suburbs: treatment pages, booking links and consent-based galleries.
- [Interior Designer Website Design, Hinsdale](https://elimenti.com/interior-designer-websites/): Websites for interior designers in Hinsdale, Western Springs and the western suburbs: project pages, process and qualified inquiries.
- [Custom Home Builder Website Design, Hinsdale](https://elimenti.com/custom-home-builder-websites/): Websites for custom home builders in Hinsdale, Western Springs and the western suburbs: project galleries, process and service area.
- [Websites for Landscape Design Firms, Hinsdale](https://elimenti.com/landscape-design-websites/): Websites for landscape design-build firms in Hinsdale, Burr Ridge and the western suburbs: projects, process and service area.
- [Boutique Website Design for Independent Shops](https://elimenti.com/boutique-websites/): Websites for independent boutiques and showrooms in the Chicago suburbs: photo-led, fast on phones and linked to your store.
- [Car Club Website Design](https://elimenti.com/car-club-websites/): Websites for private car clubs and automotive groups, from the studio behind 1 of 1 Car Club's site. Based in Hinsdale, IL, working US-wide.
- [Classic and Marque Car Club Websites](https://elimenti.com/classic-car-club-websites/): Websites for classic and marque car clubs: chapters, archives, member directories, magazines and events, and moving off Joomla or Drupal to WordPress.

## Guides

- [Website Guides for Business Owners](https://elimenti.com/guides/): Plain-English website guides for independent business owners, grouped by question: cost, timing, platforms, hiring, redesigns and local search.
- [What a High-End Website Costs in Chicago](https://elimenti.com/guides/website-cost-western-suburbs/): What a custom website costs an independent business in Chicago and the western suburbs, what each price level gets you and what to ask before you hire.
- [Squarespace vs Custom Website: Which Fits?](https://elimenti.com/guides/squarespace-vs-custom-website/): An honest comparison for independent businesses: what Squarespace does well, where a custom site pulls ahead, three-year costs and how to choose.
- [What Makes a Website Look High-End](https://elimenti.com/guides/what-makes-a-website-look-high-end/): The details that make a business website look high-end or cheap: type, photography, restraint, copy, speed and the small things customers notice first.
- [Wix vs Squarespace vs WordPress vs Custom](https://elimenti.com/guides/wix-squarespace-wordpress-or-custom/): Wix, Squarespace, WordPress or custom code for an independent business: cost, speed, editing and ownership compared, with data from 150 local sites.
- [Questions to Ask a Web Designer Before You Sign](https://elimenti.com/guides/questions-to-ask-a-web-designer/): Fourteen questions to ask a web designer before you sign, what a good answer sounds like, the red flags, and how Elimenti answers each one.
- [What to Do If Your Web Designer Disappears](https://elimenti.com/guides/web-designer-disappeared/): Web designer disappeared? Find who holds your domain, hosting and logins, get each one back, and keep the handoff list that stops it happening again.
- [Website Redesign or Refresh? How to Tell](https://elimenti.com/guides/website-redesign-vs-refresh/): Redesign or refresh? A fifteen-minute scorecard for your own website, what each result means, and how each option is priced and how long it takes.
- [How Long Does a Custom Website Take?](https://elimenti.com/guides/how-long-does-a-website-take/): How long a custom website takes, what each stage waits on, what adds weeks and a checklist to get ready. Most of our projects launch in 4 to 6 weeks.
- [Med Spa Website Cost: Prices and an Example](https://elimenti.com/guides/med-spa-website-cost/): What a med spa website costs: market prices, what drives the price, a first-year budget line by line and the patient-privacy items to plan for.
- [Local SEO for Boutiques in the Suburbs](https://elimenti.com/guides/local-seo-for-boutiques/): Local SEO for an independent boutique: your Google Business Profile, reviews, the pages worth having and the small website fixes that make the phone ring.
- [Car Club Website Examples: What Works and Why](https://elimenti.com/guides/car-club-website-examples/): Real car club websites, from marque clubs to invitation-only ones: what each does well, one thing it misses, and what your club's site needs.
